notes: The Fold. True; the town won't believe it. Goblin-sourced, so only offered when goblins.standing is not hostile. Told by Kettleback and Snig.
text: Big One doesn't eat people. Big One puts them in the soft room and gives us bread for them.

followUp.text: Beds, and bread. All of it. The town will never believe me if I say so, so I shan't.
